arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Malone argued the statute uses plain, ordinary words.
She stated the tolling provision is unambiguous.
Ms. Ellickson argued the side that brought the case was not serving his federal term.
She noted he was in state jail for new crimes.
